name: Swarm
tagline: A few rules of liking, a crowd that comes alive
about: Particle life. Every dot has a colour, and one small table says how much each colour wants to be near each other colour. Up close everything pushes apart, so nothing collapses to a point. That is the whole rule set, and out of it come cells, worms, chases and slow orbiting crowds that nobody drew. What gets me is the lopsided rules: when amber likes coral but coral cannot stand amber, you get a chase that never ends. Press New rules until something surprises you, then click into it and watch it heal.
